notes: Tuition: not stated for this programme for a non-EU applicant. The fee pages show ISEE-based bands, regional tax and stamp duty, but no single amount or a lowest-highest range that the pages state applies to a full-time Bachelor student from outside the EU. Deadline for uploading the E-Apostille (31 October 2026) is a document-verification deadline, not an application deadline; no application opening or closing date for this programme is stated on the supplied pages.

note.fr: Le Politecnico exige que le diplôme de fin d'études secondaires soit accompagné d'une traduction officielle si le document n'est pas en italien, anglais, français ou espagnol.
note.en: Politecnico requires the school-leaving certificate to be accompanied by an official translation if the document is not in Italian, English, French or Spanish.

evidence.quote: Entrambi i documenti dovranno essere accompagnati da traduzione ufficiale se non disponibili in inglese, francese o spagnolo.

note.fr: Le diplôme final de fin d'études secondaires doit être téléchargé via les Services en ligne au plus tard le 10 septembre 2026.
note.en: The final school-leaving certificate must be uploaded via the Online Services by 10 September 2026 at the latest.

evidence.quote: La scadenza per caricare il titolo di studio è il 10 settembre 2026.

note.fr: Une déclaration de valeur, un supplément au certificat, une attestation de comparabilité CIMEA ou une attestation de correspondance CIMEA doit être téléchargée avant le 31 octobre 2026.
note.en: A Declaration of Value, Certificate Supplement, CIMEA Statement of Comparability or CIMEA Statement of Correspondence must be uploaded by 31 October 2026.

evidence.quote: La scadenza per caricare la Dichiarazione di Valore, oppure il Certificate Supplement, oppure l’Attestato di Comparabilità, oppure l’Attestato di Corrispondenza, è il 31 ottobre 2026.
